Fuel Prices Stable Across Indian Cities Amid Global Tensions

Petrol and diesel prices remained unchanged on August 16 and 17 across major Indian cities including Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, and Bengaluru. The stability in fuel rates occurred amidst ongoing international discussions, specifically mentioning stalled US-Iran talks concerning the Strait of Hormuz.
